projects.title: BTC Forecast API
projects.tech: Python, FastAPI, CatBoost, scikit-learn, MongoDB, Docker

bullets.t: Built a forecasting service end to end: Binance market data ingestion, feature engineering, and a weighted ensemble of CatBoost, Random Forest, and Logistic Regression models served through a versioned REST API.

Added bcrypt-hashed API keys, rate limiting, and health checks, plus model evaluation (ROC AUC, precision, recall), drift metrics, and a retraining flow with before-and-after metric review ahead of deployment.
Split a Keras transformer model into its own Docker service to isolate TensorFlow dependencies from the main API.
Laravel REST API with a TypeScript storefront and a mobile-wrapped admin app for inventory, orders, and RBAC.
Ticket management system for SLU CCA events, deployed on university servers. Led requirements gathering, stakeholder communication, and UI/UX design.
